prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a quiet moment in a grand library reading room. On the left, an elderly woman with silver hair sits on a plush velvet chair, her posture upright and dignified. Next to her rests a leather-bound book with gold embossing, its pages slightly yellowed. In the center, a young man in a blue sweater leans over a wooden table, his elbow resting firmly on the surface. He is pointing at a detailed map spread out before him. Across from him, a librarian with round glasses looks at the map intently, her expression focused and serious. To the right, a student with a backpack slung over one shoulder stands near a tall bookshelf, holding a stack of three hardcover novels. Beside the student, a tabby cat sleeps peacefully on a low stool, its tail curled around its paws. Near the window, a child in a yellow raincoat reaches for a globe sitting on a pedestal. An older gentleman in a tweed jacket hands a small notebook to the child, their fingers briefly touching. Behind them, a potted fern with lush green leaves adds a touch of nature to the scene. A brass lamp with a green shade sits on the corner of the table, casting a soft glow. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the room. There is no coffee cup on any of the tables.
